stories.recap: Implemented the responsive app shell, linked hierarchy breadcrumbs, synchronized document and visible page titles, route focus announcements, labelled landmarks, lifecycle navigation, and a permission-filtered command registry with fuzzy search, recents, shared shortcuts, destructive modifiers, and explicit nested-layer Escape ordering. Round 2 distinguishes mobile navigation closes from dismissals so route changes keep focus on main, keeps breadcrumb focus glow outside the ellipsis clip, and derives every supporting typography, dimension, stacking, icon, and touch-target token from MASTER.md; a planted 999px sidebar width failed by token name before restoration. Added @radix-ui/react-dialog because the binding design requires Radix focus trapping/layer semantics, replacing bespoke modal plumbing; added @phosphor-icons/react because the binding design mandates Phosphor and no existing icon dependency provides it. Browser coverage includes zero-frame palette opening, keyboard-only navigation and dismissal paths at 375px, responsive widths, greyscale, and axe in both themes.
stories.title: App shell: nav, breadcrumbs, command palette, focus management, skip links
